messages:
ashok: noticing a ~30% throughput drop across a subset of us-west-2 inference workers starting ~09:12. several worker restarts and a couple GPU OOMs. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/ingress/cluster/abc :eyes:
maria: thanks — can you paste the p99 latency and active worker count for the window? also any recent rollout?
sam: p99 jumped from 120ms -> 420ms, active workers for that shard dropped from 48 -> 36 due to restarts. nvml logs attached: `GPU 2: cuMemAlloc fail, OOM` repeated.
ivy: saw the runtime selector flip on those hosts to kernel-mode `fast32-kv` after last kernel-selection change yesterday (deploy b6c7e9). that path increases temporary allocation for fused attention for short sequences. could be memory pressure + small-batch surge. :thinking_face:
perf-bot: automated alert: memory-fragmentation-index spike on nodes {i-0a, i-0b, i-0c}, correlate with kernel-selector=b6c7e9.
ben: if kernel change is suspect we should canary rollback the selector on a small set first. also consider throttling batch concurrency before rolling back.
ash: (was in thread) re: batching - we saw a lot of tiny requests from a single noisy tenant at 09:10 which increased small-batch churn. they spike keys in KV cache and trigger eviction churn.
maria: can we get a quick heap/KV snapshot from one affected worker? `rd-prof dump --target i-0a --type kvsnapshot`
sam: pasted snapshot: kv-cache size rose then oscillated; >60% occupied slabs in small-object arena, many tiny evictions. flame snippet: `attention_fused_fast32` accounts for ~28% of peak transient allocation.
ivy: hypothesis: kernel `fast32-kv` has slightly different allocation pattern (larger temporary workspace) which when combined with KV slab fragmentation + noisy tenant tiny batches leads to OOM/restarts. two levers: kernel rollback OR reduce per-worker concurrency / batch.max_tokens.
ash: mitigation in prod now: `deploy-bot` can we throttle tenant X to 20rps and set per-worker concurrent_batches=2 on affected pool?
deploy-bot: throttle applied to tenant X (20rps). concurrent_batches set to 2 for pool us-west-2-a. monitoring for 15m.
ash: also pushed a canary rollback of kernel-selector -> previous stable (commit a1d2c3) on 3 nodes. will report back in 10m.
ash: (10m) canary nodes recovered, no OOMs, throughput returned to baseline on those hosts, p99 back to ~130ms.
maria: good signal. action items: 1) revert kernel change for the region (ben) 2) add guardrail in selector to avoid choosing fast32-kv when free_vram < 20% (ivy) 3) KV slab compaction work (sam) 4) rate-limit noisy tenant while we do compaction (ashok). owners assigned.
ben: starting region rollback now.
ivy: I'll open a PR with the selector guard and add a regression test that simulates many tiny requests + KV pressure.
sam: I'll schedule a KV compaction run / background defrag for the affected pool tonight.
ash: thanks all. follow-up retro scheduled 2026-03-20 16:00 in #incidents-retro. :white_check_mark:
